title: Two-Storey Residence with Basement & Pool
description: A modern two-storey residential property with a basement, swimming pool, and pool bar, designed to blend contemporary architecture with tropical outdoor living. The project features carefully landscaped grounds, a dedicated pool and entertainment area, and distinctive thatched-roof outdoor structures that create a private resort-inspired atmosphere.

title: Modern Two-Storey Residence
description: A contemporary two-storey residential project designed with clean architectural lines, functional spaces, and a strong connection to its surrounding landscape. The residence features a modern minimalist façade with crisp white walls, wide roof overhangs, warm wood-tone ceiling accents, and natural stone detailing that adds texture and character to the exterior. A generous covered carport and entrance area provide practical functionality, while the landscaped grounds and carefully planned walkways enhance the home's outdoor environment. The elevated layout and expansive outdoor areas create a comfortable and private residential setting that balances modern design with the natural tropical surroundings.
